log.text: Hello, I'd like to book a private room at Jade Star Chinese Dining for 5 people on Wednesday, 16 December 2026 at 4pm. Could you please make that booking?

Welcome to Jade Star Chinese Dining 吉星饭厅. The Tulip Room 郁金香厅 is held for you on Wed 16 Dec 2026 at 4pm for 5 guests. A 6-digit code has gone to your phone, so please enter it within 15 minutes to confirm; the RM 100 booking fee is added to your bill at check-out.

data.confirm: The person confirms with the 6-digit code sent by SMS to their phone. No agent can confirm.
